KyberSwap AMM operates as an automated market maker on public blockchains. KyberSwap AMM enables token swaps through liquidity pools rather than an intermediary order book. KyberSwap AMM relies on smart contracts to execute trades.

Akropolis operates as a decentralized finance protocol on the Ethereum blockchain. Akropolis pools user funds to generate yield through lending protocols. Akropolis relies on smart contracts to manage deposits and withdrawals without intermediaries.
